Q2 2025 update: The average electricity price in the world is USD 0.167 kWh for residential users and USD 0.163 USD per kWh for businesses. The highest residential electricity prices are in Europe at USD 0.245 per kWh and the lowest are in Asia with USD 0.084. Africa (0.127), Oceania (0.240), North America (0.139), and South America (0.206) are in between.

The highest business electricity prices are in Oceania at USD 0.266 per kWh and the lowest prices are in Africa (0.123) and Asia (0.107). On the other continents: Europe (0.204), North America (0.155), and South America (0.200).
